mostWorthwhile.text: Adding stretch receptors was most worthwhile: it connected muscle activity back to the nervous system and explained how a reach can be adjusted as it happens.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the motor nerves felt the least engaging because it was the only offered combination and its general purpose was already apparent.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the spinal cord participates in local responses rather than simply carrying signals to and from the brain.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; even the required combinations had clear purposes in connecting sight, control, movement and feedback.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the final feedback connection made me curious about how the body supports and adjusts the arm's work next.
